# Qwen attribution

Revity's chat preview uses original, unmodified Qwen3-0.6B weights and tokenizer
published by the Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud, under Apache License 2.0.

Upstream: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
Revision: c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca

Revity is an independent interface and is not an official Qwen product.
No fine-tuning, training, or adaptation has been performed on these weights.
The generated Revity starter datasets have not been used to train this model.
